Care & FAQ

How long do lash extensions last?

Clusters last about 2–3 weeks and individual sets about 4–6 weeks with good aftercare. Refills keep them full.

How should I prepare for lashes?

Come with clean lashes and no mascara. Avoid water and steam for the first 24 hours after your set.

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes, when a technician is free. Booking ahead on WhatsApp guarantees your slot.

How do I care for a new piercing?

Clean twice daily with saline, don't twist the stud, and avoid swimming for two weeks. Message us if anything feels off.
